title: A channel: one account the team uses or plans to use (WS-175)
description: channels/<channel>/channel.json in ws-team-crm-private. Proposed by crm@web-summit.jose on 5 November 2026 from board WS-175 and the article one-place-for-every-conversation; the same shape as the other record kinds (id, type, sources, updated_at, updated_by). Lives in the private CRM: the handle, the owner and the state are the team's own knowledge.

id.description: the folder name: <platform>-<account>, for example linkedin-riskmandate, email-outreach

brand.description: whose name the account is under: riskmandate, promptugal, a person's id, or null

handle.description: the account's handle or page name; null while planned

owner.description: the person who posts or sends (a person id); agents draft, a person posts

drafted_by.description: the agents that draft for it

cadence.description: for example 'one post a day to 9 November'
